# Committed gate-key registry for the kind performance gate.
#
# Format, one record per line, exactly three whitespace-separated fields
# and an optional trailing # comment:
#
#     <phase-key>  <field>  <value>
#
# <phase-key> is the performance-report basename the suite writes, minus
# the _performance_report.json suffix. <field> is either a report JSON
# field, in which case <value> is a benchmark-action alert ratio or the
# literal `none`, or one of the reserved fields below.
#
#   none                 screen the key out of the gate AND record that the
#                        screen was deliberate. A key with no entry at all is
#                        an error, not a skip: benchmark-action silently skips
#                        a key it cannot match, so an omission and a deliberate
#                        screen are indistinguishable on the wire without this.
#                        A screened key still lands in the informational CV
#                        file and the chart history. It cannot fail a step.
#   timeout_seconds      the timeout argument at the phase's Report* call site.
#                        A sample at or above 0.95 of it is censored: the
#                        monitor loop exited on the clock, so the value is the
#                        timeout rather than a measurement.
#   assert_max_seconds   the suite's own absolute total_time bound for the
#                        phase, from TotalTimeThreshold. A sample at or above
#                        it is censored too. Under an unclamped run the suite
#                        would have failed the leg, so such a sample only
#                        reaches the batch when a provider has widened the
#                        bound through KARPENTER_PERF_THRESHOLDS. Censoring on
#                        it keeps the relative gate's statistic independent of
#                        that override.
#   derived_for_n        under the reserved phase key _gate. The sample count
#                        the thresholds were derived for. They bound the
#                        dispersion of the batch MEDIAN at that n, which is 3 to
#                        10 times smaller than one sample's. The aggregator
#                        refuses to gate a smaller batch. Replayed against 33
#                        real upstream main runs, which take one iteration each,
#                        these thresholds fire on 93.8% of them; at n=10 their
#                        union false-positive rate is 0.49%.
#   cpu_core_cap         under the reserved phase key _gate. The controller CPU
#                        limit, so the aggregator can compute each key's
#                        ceiling from the batch it just took. A key whose
#                        ceiling falls below its shipped threshold is
#                        unfalsifiable and is screened at run time with a
#                        named warning rather than passing green.
#
# THRESHOLD VALUES ARE PROVISIONAL. They are T_min from the n=10-per-side
# fresh-runner measurement, runs 35680298794 and 35680365019, raised to a
# 1.01 floor and rounded up. kp-ojhb8u3 is deriving the scale_out detection
# method and may revise them. The mechanism in this file is independent of
# the values.
#
# WHAT GATES, AND WHY. The axis is the report writer, not the phase name.
# ReportScaleOut (report.go:107) blocks on one Eventually and hardcodes
# Rounds:1 at report.go:146, so its total_time cannot alias a poll count.
# ReportConsolidation and ReportDrift each run a loop that RETURNS when the
# timeout expires (report.go:349, report.go:252), so their total_time can
# record the monitor's own sleep schedule instead of the code under test.
# Measured: total_time = A + 55*R + 30*Q on consolidation, R^2 of total_time
# on rounds 0.844 to 0.972, and corr(rounds, nodes removed) -0.818. On
# drift_execution the same defect is latent, not absent: corr +0.97, slope
# 49.3 s per round. Every loop-instrumented key is therefore screened here.
#
# Re-admitting a screened key is a one-line change to this file plus the
# evidence that justifies it. It is not a code change. kp-pt1hu0o section 5d
# lists the four conditions consolidation has to meet first.

# ---- file-level parameters ----
_gate                                          derived_for_n                      2      # SMOKE ONLY, real value is 10. runs 35680298794 and 35680365019, 10 independent runners per side
_gate                                          cpu_core_cap                       2.0    # Makefile:9, --set controller.resources.limits.cpu=2
